description: This file contains utility functions for handling X.509 v3 extensions, including parsing, string conversions, IP address handling, and name matching, primarily used in OpenSSL's cryptographic library.

methods.name: x509V3_add_len_value
methods.description: Adds a name-value pair to a stack of configuration values, handling memory allocation and duplication.

methods.name: X509V3_add_value
methods.description: Adds a string value with a name to a configuration value stack.

methods.name: x509V3_add_value_asn1_string
methods.description: Adds an ASN1_STRING value with a name to a configuration value stack.

methods.name: X509V3_conf_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a CONF_VALUE structure.

methods.name: X509V3_add_value_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean value as a string ('TRUE' or 'FALSE') to a configuration stack.

methods.name: bignum_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to a string, using hex for large numbers and decimal for small ones.

methods.name: i2s_ASN1_ENUMERATED
methods.description: Converts ASN1_ENUMERATED to string representation.

methods.name: i2s_ASN1_INTEGER
methods.description: Converts ASN1_INTEGER to string representation.

methods.name: s2i_ASN1_INTEGER
methods.description: Parses a string into an ASN1_INTEGER.

methods.name: X509V3_add_value_int
methods.description: Adds an ASN1_INTEGER value as a string to a configuration stack.

methods.name: X509V3_bool_from_string
methods.description: Converts a string to ASN1_BOOLEAN.

methods.name: X509V3_get_value_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a configuration value.

methods.name: X509V3_get_value_int
methods.description: Retrieves an ASN1_INTEGER from a configuration value.

methods.name: X509V3_parse_list
methods.description: Parses a line of text into a list of configuration values.

methods.name: strip_spaces
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: x509v3_bytes_to_hex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a colon-separated hex string.

methods.name: x509v3_hex_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a colon-separated hex string to a byte array.

methods.name: x509v3_conf_name_matches
methods.description: Checks if a configuration name matches a given prefix.

methods.name: X509_get1_email
methods.description: Extracts email addresses from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_get1_ocsp
methods.description: Extracts OCSP responder URLs from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_REQ_get1_email
methods.description: Extracts email addresses from an X509 request.

methods.name: get_email
methods.description: Collects email addresses from X509 name and general names.

methods.name: append_ia5
methods.description: Appends an IA5String email address to a stack, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: X509_email_free
methods.description: Frees a stack of email address strings.

methods.name: equal_nocase
methods.description: Compares two strings case-insensitively.

methods.name: equal_case
methods.description: Compares two byte arrays for equality.

methods.name: equal_email
methods.description: Case-insensitive comparison of email addresses, focusing on domain part.

methods.name: wildcard_match
methods.description: Matches a subject against a wildcard pattern.

methods.name: x509v3_looks_like_dns_name
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a string looks like a DNS name.

methods.name: do_check_string
methods.description: Checks if an ASN1_STRING matches a given string with optional type and peername extraction.

methods.name: do_x509_check
methods.description: Performs hostname, email, or IP address validation against an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_check_host
methods.description: Checks if a hostname matches the certificate.

methods.name: X509_check_email
methods.description: Checks if an email address matches the certificate.

methods.name: X509_check_ip
methods.description: Checks if an IP address matches the certificate.

methods.name: X509_check_ip_asc
methods.description: Checks if an IP address string matches the certificate.

methods.name: a2i_IPADDRESS
methods.description: Converts an IP address string to ASN1_OCTET_STRING.

methods.name: a2i_IPADDRESS_NC
methods.description: Converts a CIDR IP address string to ASN1_OCTET_STRING.

methods.name: x509v3_a2i_ipadd
methods.description: Parses an IP address string into binary form, IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: ipv4_from_asc
methods.description: Parses IPv4 address string into 4-byte array.

methods.name: ipv6_from_asc
methods.description: Parses IPv6 address string into 16-byte array.

methods.name: ipv6_cb
methods.description: Callback for parsing IPv6 address components.

methods.name: ipv6_hex
methods.description: Converts a hex string to IPv6 bytes.

methods.name: X509V3_NAME_from_section
methods.description: Creates an X509_NAME from a configuration section.
